hook: The most nominated name *isn't on the cover*.
dek: Édgar Barrera leads the Latin Grammys with 10 nominations, mostly for other artists' records. Tonight, 8 p.m. ET on Univision.
title: The Most Nominated Name at Tonight's Latin Grammys Isn't on the Album Cover
yt_title: Latin Grammys 2026: Édgar Barrera and the Names to Watch

slides.label: Tonight
slides.text: The *27th Latin Grammys* air *tonight at 8 p.m. ET* on *Univision*, live from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas.

slides.label: The leader
slides.text: Songwriter and producer *Édgar Barrera* leads the field with *10 nominations*, mostly for work on *other artists'* records.

slides.label: Top races
slides.text: *CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso* are up for Record *and* Album of the Year. *KAROL G*, *Anitta* and *Rawayana* are in the Album race too.

slides.label: Person of the Year
slides.text: *Daddy Yankee* is the Latin Recording Academy's *2026 Person of the Year* and is scheduled to *perform*.

slides.label: Best New Artist
slides.text: *11 nominees*, from *Delilah* to *Zeca Veloso*. Most aren't household names yet. That's why we're watching.
